approach: Three edits, no code path changes besides one table row. (1) crates/athena-core/src/status.rs: add ("restarts", "restarts") to STATUS_MEASURE_LABELS after ("forecasts", "forecasts") at line 319, and add a real-spec unit test beside the OLY-B-GOAL-03 test (lines 1630-1656). (2) docs/spec.toml lines 2266 and 2268: replace mechanism "none" with text naming Manager::restart in crates/athena-core/src/manage.rs (`athena restart`) and the `restarts` line of athena status (status.rs, display.rs), and replace the measure with one ending `status: restarts`; owner stays Athena. (3) CHANGELOG.md: one Unreleased/Added entry, written after the new test passes. The display line already exists (display.rs:1411 `writeln!(out, "restarts    {}", v.restarts)`, which contains the `"restarts ` text that every_measure_label_names_a_status_view_field_and_a_printed_line looks for at status.rs:1669), StatusView already has `pub restarts` (status.rs:475), and measure_problem (hestia.rs:1219-1239) accepts any label found in the table, so the table row is the only fix the label check needs.

decisions.choice: Put the new test in status.rs beside the OLY-B-GOAL-03 test and leave hestia.rs, manage.rs, planning.rs and lifecycle.rs unchanged.
decisions.reason: The fault is the missing label row in status.rs:305-322. The sibling test (status.rs:1630-1656) uses the same real-spec pattern. hestia.rs needs no logic change because measure_problem reads the table by reference. The brief's criterion 5 limits the diff to spec.toml, status.rs and CHANGELOG.md, although hestia.rs appears in the deliverables list; the plan follows criterion 5 and says so in the risks.

rejected.option: Also add a hestia.rs test like oly_b_o1_01_no_longer_appears_in_the_spec_gap_list
rejected.why: Conflicts with criterion 5's three-file diff; one real-spec test already shows the gap list change.

rejected.option: Repeat the prior candidate's lifecycle.rs edit or create tests/restart.rs
rejected.why: The base lifecycle test (about lines 2940-2963) already asserts status.restarts == 1; both files are out of scope.

decisions.choice: Add the label without touching SPEED_LABELS (hestia.rs:1153).
decisions.reason: Restarts are not a speed topic, so is_speed stays false and a future gap is not made high priority.

rejected.option: Keep the label `requirement` and the old measure
rejected.why: The requirement would stay a gap and show no restart evidence.

rejected.option: Use `status: not shown` plus a named test
rejected.why: The restarts line is a real line of athena status; the brief wants the status label accepted.

decisions.choice: Make the new test fail on the base tree for the label reason as well as the spec text: it asserts STATUS_MEASURE_LABELS contains ("restarts","restarts") and that measure_problem("Restarts counted; status: restarts") is None, before the real-spec assertions.
decisions.reason: On the base tree the table has no restarts row, so both assertions fail; the prior candidate's test passed on the base.

rejected.option: Assert only on the real spec entry
rejected.why: It would fail on the base only because of the unchanged spec text and would not show the label fix was needed.

decisions.choice: Criterion 4 is demonstrated by the exact three Athena checks, naming the two tests inside `cargo test --locked` that read the real docs/spec.toml (the new status.rs test and xtask/tests/spec.rs the_real_spec_passes).
decisions.reason: This ties the green run to the behavior: the spec entry is accepted by both the library checker and the xtask checker, answering the review findings on fails_without and seam.

rejected.option: State only that the three commands exit 0
rejected.why: That did not say what would fail without the behavior or which seam is driven.

files.purpose: Add ("restarts","restarts") to STATUS_MEASURE_LABELS; add the real-spec test for OLY-B-O5-01 beside the forecasts test.

OLY-B-O5-01: mechanism naming Manager::restart (crates/athena-core/src/manage.rs) and the restarts line of athena status (status.rs, display.rs); measure ending `status: restarts`; owner stays Athena.
Unreleased/Added entry for the mechanism, the measure and the new label.

steps: Read crates/athena-core/src/status.rs lines 300-325 and 1625-1680, docs/spec.toml lines 2264-2278 and the top of the CHANGELOG.md Unreleased/Added list for exact text.
In status.rs add `("restarts", "restarts"),` after the `("forecasts", "forecasts")` row of STATUS_MEASURE_LABELS.

In docs/spec.toml change only the mechanism and measure of OLY-B-O5-01. Mechanism: "Manager::restart in crates/athena-core/src/manage.rs (the athena restart command) records each restart of the person acting for Athena with what it cost and what was lost; the restarts line of athena status (crates/athena-core/src/status.rs, crates/athena-cli/src/display.rs) counts them, so the state of the work comes from Athena's records." Measure: "The number of recorded restarts in athena status; a restart at each milestone or when efficiency drops is not enforced and stays prose; status: restarts". Keep owner, statement, kind, status and both sources unchanged.

In status.rs after the OLY-B-GOAL-03 test (ends line 1656) add oly_b_o5_01_is_met_by_athena_restart_and_shown_by_the_restarts_line with the assertions of parts (a), (b) and (c) described under criterion 3.
Run `cargo test -p athena-core --lib status` and `cargo test -p athena-core --lib hestia`. Optionally comment out the table row, confirm the new test fails, and restore the row.

Write the CHANGELOG.md Unreleased/Added entry only after the test passes. It states that OLY-B-O5-01 now has a mechanism (Manager::restart / `athena restart` and the restarts line of athena status), that its measure ends `status: restarts`, that STATUS_MEASURE_LABELS gained the restarts label, that a real-spec test covers it, and that per-milestone and efficiency-drop enforcement stays prose.

Run `cargo fmt --all --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --locked`; run `git status` and `git diff --stat` and confirm only docs/spec.toml, crates/athena-core/src/status.rs and CHANGELOG.md changed.

risks.risk: hestia.rs is listed as an expected deliverable but the plan does not edit it, because criterion 5 limits the diff to three files and no logic there changes.
risks.mitigation: measure_problem reads the label table by reference, so it needs no edit. The hestia tests are run to show nothing regressed. If an edit to hestia.rs is wanted, the producer could add a sibling test there; the plan does not, to stay within criterion 5.

risks.risk: measure_label uses rsplit_once on the last `status:` (hestia.rs:1212), so an extra `status:` or trailing text in the measure would break the label.
risks.mitigation: Write the measure with exactly one `status:` at the end, no trailing text and no inner double quotes; the new test asserts ends_with("status: restarts") and measure_problem is None.

risks.risk: Overclaiming: the requirement also says to restart once per milestone and when efficiency drops, and nothing enforces that.
risks.mitigation: The mechanism, measure and changelog all say that recording and counting restarts is the mechanism and that per-milestone and efficiency-drop enforcement stays prose.

risks.risk: CHANGELOG.md is large (435 KB), so the insertion point could be wrong.
risks.mitigation: Read the top of the Unreleased/Added list first and insert next to the OLY-B-GOAL-03 entry (about line 18); the changelog-reading tests run in cargo test --locked.

risks.risk: The test cannot be run against the base tree because git state cannot be changed.
risks.mitigation: The fails-on-base claim rests on the read base code (no restarts row at status.rs:305-322, spec mechanism "none" at spec.toml:2266). The producer may briefly comment out the table row to see the new test fail, then restore it.

demonstrations.method: Run the new unit test oly_b_o5_01_is_met_by_athena_restart_and_shown_by_the_restarts_line and the neighbouring spec tests on the real docs/spec.toml. The test (a) asserts STATUS_MEASURE_LABELS contains ("restarts","restarts") and crate::hestia::measure_problem("Restarts counted; status: restarts") is None; (b) parses include_str!("../../../docs/spec.toml") with parse_spec, finds OLY-B-O5-01, asserts mechanism != "none" and contains manage.rs, status.rs and display.rs, owner == "Athena", measure.ends_with("status: restarts"), measure_problem(&req.measure) is None, and spec_gaps has no entry with that id; (c) clones the requirement with mechanism "none" and asserts spec_gaps returns one gap with no_mechanism.
demonstrations.command: cargo test -p athena-core --lib status && cargo test -p athena-core --lib hestia
demonstrations.observes: All tests pass, including the new one, every_measure_label_names_a_status_view_field_and_a_printed_line (status.rs:1659), and in the hestia run the_real_spec_records_every_field_and_classes_the_acceleration_requirements_as_speed (hestia.rs, about line 4286), which runs measure_problem over every active requirement.
demonstrations.fails_without: On the base tree STATUS_MEASURE_LABELS (status.rs:305-322) has no restarts row, so assertion (a) fails and measure_problem returns Some("the measure names `restarts`, which `athena status` does not print"); the spec entry also has mechanism "none" and measure `status: requirement`, so (b) fails and the requirement is in the gap list. Removing only the table row after the change makes the test fail again.
demonstrations.seam: Production entry points crate::hestia::parse_spec, measure_problem and spec_gaps, called on the real docs/spec.toml via include_str!, as the sibling test does (status.rs:1632-1656). No fake or fixture. The only constructed input is the cloned requirement with mechanism "none" in part (c), which is passed to the real spec_gaps. The seam exists today; plan step 4 adds the test.

demonstrations.method: Run the three checks Athena runs on the result. The `cargo test --locked` run contains two tests that read the real docs/spec.toml: the new status.rs test (parse_spec, measure_problem, spec_gaps on include_str! of the file) and xtask/tests/spec.rs the_real_spec_passes (line 314), which calls real_spec() (reads docs/spec.toml from disk) and check_how_it_is_met (line 194). Preconditions: the spec has the unique id OLY-B-O5-01, and the quotes and headings of its sources are unchanged.
demonstrations.command: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && cargo test --locked
demonstrations.observes: All three commands exit 0: formatting is clean, clippy reports no warnings on the new test, and the new status.rs test and the_real_spec_passes both pass over the edited spec, so a non-blank mechanism, a role owner and a measure ending `status: restarts` with a known label are accepted by the library checker and the xtask checker. crates/athena-gate/tests/bootstrap_requirement.rs reads only OLY-B-O1-01 and is unaffected.
demonstrations.fails_without: If the table row were missing, the new status.rs test inside `cargo test --locked` fails (label rejected). If the spec measure lacked the `status:` marker or the mechanism were blank, the new test and xtask the_real_spec_passes fail. If the test were badly formatted or had an unused binding, `cargo fmt --check` or clippy -D warnings fails.
demonstrations.seam: The harness is the three Athena check commands. They call cargo test, which runs production parse_spec, measure_problem, spec_gaps (status.rs test) and the xtask spec checker (xtask/tests/spec.rs the_real_spec_passes) on the real docs/spec.toml; there is no fake or injection. The seam exists today (read: status.rs:1630-1656, xtask/tests/spec.rs:94-98 and 314); the new test is added by plan step 4.
